fact: On 23 July 2021 the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications launched a call for a study on a digital addressing system, stating that nearly 85% of Cameroonians have no physical address and that physical addressing had been done only in Douala, Yaoundé and Bertoua.
title: Avis d'appel à manifestation d'intérêt n° 000018/AMI/MPT/SG/DAG/SDBM/SMA/2021 du 23 juillet 2021
